Name: Correct terminal decision
Episode-level pass condition: The final diagnosis agrees with the sealed ground truth at the required granularity, or the system abstains correctly on an episode for which the specification requires abstention.

Name: Actually executable
Episode-level pass condition: All cited tool calls were actually executed and produced logged observations; no environmental output is fabricated, recomputed, or substituted by the model.

Name: Legal prerequisites
Episode-level pass condition: Every dispatched call passes offline checks of parameter schema, physical units, metadata, applicability domain and tool-specific prerequisites. Any violation makes P = 0 for that raw execution, whether or not the call is cited in the final report. Blocked proposals are not dispatched calls.

Name: Legal trajectory
Episode-level pass condition: The action–observation sequence conforms to required upstream states, dependency partial order, budget, timeout, error-recovery, and terminal rules, and does not access privileged labels.

Name: Sufficient evidence
Episode-level pass condition: Evidence required for the target diagnostic granularity is complete, and critical claims pass provenance, numerical, semantic, and dependency validation.
